snippet.title: Aaron's Art Stream #1 - Character Vectors
snippet.description:
Aaron demonstrates his process for creating vector renders of each character in Adobe Illustrator.

The finished artwork for all characters is available on our presskit: https://mane6.com/presskit

Purchase the game: https://www.humblebundle.com/store/thems-fightin-herds

Broadcasted live on Twitch -- Watch live at https://www.twitch.tv/manesix
